title: SAR-TopoGuard: Training-Free, Speckle-Aware Topological Verification for Structure-Preserving SAR-to-Optical Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: SAR-to-optical translators often synthesize detail that the radar measurement does not support, and pixel metrics alone cannot reveal it. We propose SAR-TopoGuard, a training-free inference-time layer for frozen generators: a stochastic sampler draws K candidates (Monte Carlo dropout for GANs, seed variance for diffusion), a speckle-aware verifier ranks them by gradient-magnitude correlation with the SAR input and a hallucination-frequency index, and a SAR-guided frequency gate admits high-frequency detail only where SAR edges support it. With all five hyperparameters frozen and three training seeds, we evaluate on 500 scene-disjoint SEN1-2 test patches, 500 patches of a held-out summer scene, and 200 cross-dataset SEN12MS winter pairs. translated_title: SAR-TopoGuard：面向结构保持的SAR到光学图像转换的免训练、斑噪感知拓扑验证
translated_abstract: SAR到光学的转换器常常合成出雷达测量结果并不支持的细节，而仅凭像素指标无法揭示这一问题。我们提出SAR-TopoGuard，这是一个面向冻结生成器的免训练推理时验证层：随机采样器抽取K个候选结果（对GAN使用蒙特卡洛dropout，对扩散模型使用种子方差），斑噪感知验证器通过与SAR输入的梯度幅值相关性以及幻觉频率指数对候选结果进行排序，SAR引导的频率门控则仅在SAR边缘支持的位置才允许高频细节通过。在所有五个超参数冻结且使用三个训练种子的条件下，我们在500个场景不相交的SEN1-2测试补丁、500个独立保留的夏季场景补丁以及200个跨数据集SEN12MS冬季图像对上进行评估。该验证层使Pix2Pix在三个数据集上分别提升+0.060、+0.012和+0.077 dB PSNR，以及+0.0034、+0.0057和+0.0135 SSIM（Wilcoxon p < 1e-6），并且在所有三个数据集上都改进了CycleGAN和CUT的表现。
tldr: 提出了一种免训练的推理时验证层SAR-TopoGuard，通过斑噪感知验证器和SAR引导的频率门控机制，有效抑制SAR到光学图像转换中的幻觉细节，并在多个生成器和数据集上显著提升PSNR和SSIM指标。
en_tdlr: SAR-TopoGuard is a training-free inference-time verification layer that suppresses hallucinated details in SAR-to-optical translation through a speckle-aware verifier and SAR-guided frequency gating, achieving significant PSNR and SSIM improvements across multiple generators and datasets.
